newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU accuses Afghan Taleban of rights abuses.
newsitem.headline: EU accuses Afghan Taleban of rights abuses.

text.p: The European Union on Monday said it was concerned about the growing violence in Afghanistan and what it said was widespread violation of human rights, particularly against women and girls.

In a statement issued after a meeting of foreign ministers from the 15-nation bloc, the EU called for an immediate end to the fighting in Afghanistan. It also called for an end to arms shipments from outside the country.
The purist Islamist Taleban, founded by religious students, captured the Afghan capital Kabul on September 27.
It has told women they should stay at home, no longer work and be completely veiled in public. Schools are also closed to girls.
